label: sparse late-original/<DEL> feature, favored by first token g/0/h and previous input p/o (no clean rule)
explanation: Very sparse (0.04% of steps). It fires almost only at original-phase steps t>=4 and at the <DEL> step (93% of mass), and more often in long sequences (L=8-9) and late positions (orig_idx 7-8). It is almost silent in the copy phase and never fires at t<3. Firing rate goes up when the first token is g (12.8x lift), 0 or h, when the previous input is p or o, and when the current input is i/j/2/n/q. These are only soft biases. Even the best conjunction reaches about 8% precision and 27% recall on dev, so the feature looks like a diffuse combination of history-dependent hidden-state directions with no simple trigger. Magnitude is fairly uniform (median 0.12, max 0.24). The top examples tend to be in g/0/h-initial sequences right after p/o, but I did not check this systematically.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: phase=2 & in_tok=0 (+6.41), orig0=g (+5.06), phase=2 & out_tok=0 (+4.30), prev_tok=p (+3.63), phase=2 & out_tok=g (+3.61), orig0=0 (+3.53). Lower it: phase=2 (-5.84), prev3_tok=- (-5.00), orig2=2 (-2.84), orig1=2 (-2.52).
